dcterms:description: The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) is a framework for evaluating general agents in a variety of Atari games, providing a standardized interface and a set of evaluation protocols.

dcterms:description: A new environment called Goldfish and gold bucket was created to empirically test the GATS algorithm, providing a controlled setting to evaluate the performance of the model.
